blocks.text: It shall be unlawful for any person to allow or permit water or steam to escape from any water main, service or steam pipe or exhaust pipe, into or upon any street, avenue, alley or sidewalk in the City. (Code 1981 § 40-29. Code 1995 § 130-5.)
